newsitem.title: FRANCE: French Communist woman and political pioneer dies.
newsitem.headline: French Communist woman and political pioneer dies.

text.p: Communist Marie-Claude Vaillant-Couturier, a World War Two Resistance figure who pioneered the way for women into French politics, has died, the Communist Party daily L'Humanite said on Thursday. She was 84.

A survivor of the Auschwitz and Ravensbruck nazi death camps, Vaillant-Couturier, a former news photographer, won France's top award, the Legion of Honour, for her activities in the underground Resistance in Nazi-occupied France.
She was a member of parliament for the Communist Party for a quarter of a century until 1973, and a vice-president of the National Assembly from 1956 to 1958 and again in 1967-68.
The daughter of a newspaper publisher, she was the widow of former Humanite editor Paul Vaillant-Couturier.
